ns2:section.sectionText: This section is a placeholder, and cannot be registered. To register for a section with your advisor, please contact stat-registration@illinois.edu (copying your advisor as well) with your name and UIN, and you will be provided with the CRN to add. Registering for this course without instructor approval can result in a failing grade. For general Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
